FERNWAY PAY — ON-CALL ROUTING HANDBOOK (SRE), version 14 — last edited 2026-09-02

=====================================================================
1. HOW AN ALERT BECOMES A PAGE
=====================================================================
1.1 Alerts identify the failing PROCESS and host, not the service. Map the process name to its service using the service catalog (section 3). One service can run several processes.
1.2 Severity: the alert rule's base severity is adjusted by the service tier (section 2). Only SEV1 and SEV2 page a human. SEV3 and SEV4 create a ticket in the owning team's queue and page nobody, at any time of day.
1.3 The page goes to the PRIMARY on-call of the team that owns the service. Determine the owning team from the catalog, then check the team directory (section 4) for merges or hand-overs: if a team's services have been transferred, page the receiving team's rotation.
1.4 Rotations hand over at the times given in section 5. All rotation and override times are in Europe/Berlin local time. Alert timestamps are in UTC. In September 2026 Europe/Berlin is UTC+2 (CEST).
1.5 Overrides (section 6) replace the scheduled primary for the stated window. An override applies if the alert time falls inside [start, end).
1.6 Never page a secondary directly; the paging tool escalates to the secondary automatically after 10 minutes without acknowledgement.

=====================================================================
2. SEVERITY MATRIX
=====================================================================
| Alert rule            | Base severity | tier-1 service | tier-2 service | tier-3 service |
|-----------------------|---------------|----------------|----------------|----------------|
| ProcessCrashLoop      | SEV3          | raise to SEV2  | stays SEV3     | lower to SEV4  |
| HighErrorRate5xx      | SEV2          | raise to SEV1  | stays SEV2     | lower to SEV3  |
| DiskPressure          | SEV3          | stays SEV3     | stays SEV3     | lower to SEV4  |
| CertExpiry7d          | SEV3          | stays SEV3     | stays SEV3     | stays SEV3     |
| ReplicationLag        | SEV2          | stays SEV2     | lower to SEV3  | lower to SEV4  |
| QueueBacklog          | SEV3          | raise to SEV2  | stays SEV3     | lower to SEV4  |
